[[ ## decision ## ]]
two-terms

[[ ## rule ## ]]
A hyphenated term is one term only when the hyphen is used as a compound connector and the whole expression is not itself a title; in “Das Seelen-Kohärenz-Protokoll,” the hyphens are title punctuation, so “Seelen-Kohärenz” and “Protokoll” are separate terms.

[[ ## completed ## ]]
